battle.name: 西西里1848年革命
battle.theater: 巴勒莫市區與港口防線
battle.brief: 一八四八年一月九日晚，巴勒莫歌劇院觀眾在演出中要求憲法，翌日群眾湧入王宮與軍械庫，繳獲數千支火繩步槍，國民武裝由此而生；一八四九年法軍在歐迪諾率領下自墨西拿登陸，圍攻巴勒莫，莫萊長堤與海堡於五月二十四日陷落。雷管步槍在海霧中仍能擊發，攻城射擊的距離因此拉長。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰方一端是兩西西里王國的波旁王室及其軍隊。國王費迪南德二世在西西里以費迪南德一世之名統治，最初的西西里總督（副王）由其弟利奧波德親王擔任，一八四八年秋改由軍方接掌；樞密院與王廷會議處理政務，陸軍則由陸軍大臣與總參謀部指揮，本島各師的調度歸西西里軍區司令負責。交戰方另一端是起義者：巴勒莫的西西里王國眾議院於一八四八年二月開議，弗朗切斯科·拉瑪薩當選議會主席並主持政府，魯傑羅·塞蒂莫任軍務部長，下轄自願參軍的西西里軍義勇兵、巴勒莫與各城的國民警衛隊，以及由工匠與學生組成的地方民兵；此外還有西西里各郡的武裝農人與礦工游擊隊。第三方是外來的干預者：西班牙王國派出約一萬人的輔助軍團，由博爾赫斯將軍率領，於一八四八年五月抵達；奧地利帝國派出數千人的輔助軍，由努根特將軍率領，於同年七月登陸；法蘭西第二共和國則於同年十一月派歐迪諾將軍率領約一萬二千人的遠征軍自墨西拿上岸，自居為兩西西里王國的保護者，海上還有西班牙與法國分艦隊對西西里沿岸實施封鎖，英國艦隊亦一度進入巴勒莫港宣示中立。
countriesEn: On one side stood the Bourbon monarchy of the Two Sicilies with its army. The king was Ferdinand II, who ruled Sicily as Ferdinand I; the viceroy of Sicily was at first his brother, Prince Leopold of Salerno, and in the autumn of 1848 the post passed to the military. Civil government was conducted by the council of state and the royal household, while the army was directed by the ministry of war and the general staff, and the movement of the formations on the island fell to the commander of the Sicilian district. The insurgents formed the other side: the parliament of the Kingdom of Sicily opened in Palermo in February 1848, Francesco La Masa was elected its president and headed the government, and Ruggero Settimo served as minister of war. Under them stood the volunteers of the Esercito Siciliano, the National Guard of Palermo and of the other towns, and local militias made up of artisans and students; there were in addition armed peasants and bands of miners in the districts of the island. A third party intervened from abroad. Spain sent an auxiliary corps of about ten thousand men under General Borges, which reached Sicily in May 1848; the Austrian Empire sent a few thousand under General Nugent, who landed in July; and the French Second Republic landed about twelve thousand men under General Oudinot in November, who presented himself as protector of the Two Sicilies. At sea, Spanish and French squadrons blockaded the Sicilian coast, and a British squadron entered Palermo harbour for a time to proclaim British neutrality.
people: 拉瑪薩是這場革命的樞紐。他在議會裡主張西西里保有自己的憲章與行政自主，起義後當選眾議院主席並出任政府首腦，把全島的武裝整頓成一支「西西里軍」；一八四八年四月，這支義勇兵在拉瑪薩與羅塞利率領下沿通往米蘭的道路北進，準備與倫巴第的起義軍會師，北進終因糧秣與指揮分歧而夭折，拉瑪薩卻因此贏得聲望。他同時在政策上與軍方及貴族派衝突不斷，最終在一八四八年秋被逮捕並流放至馬耳他。塞蒂莫是軍事的核心：他以軍務部長身分整頓義勇兵的紀律、編制與兵站，一八四九年五月更被議會推舉為西西里軍的統帥，在最後的圍城戰中主持莫萊長堤與海堡的防禦。國王費迪南德二世是對面的決策者，他在劇院事件後被迫讓步，於一八四八年四月為兩西西里頒布憲法，五月十五日在那不勒斯宣誓，卻很快與西西里議會正面對立，召來西班牙、奧地利與法國的援軍回過頭去鎮壓自己的臣民。皮埃蒙特的總理焦貝蒂以義大利民族的名義致電支援，卻無法阻止法國介入，反而使西西里議會內的共和派（例如流亡的馬志尼）轉而質疑溫和路線。那不勒斯方面的衝突則由國王軍隊總指揮迪·基奧多鎮壓：五月二十五日他炮擊聖埃爾莫堡，驅散拒絕解散的國民警衛隊，首領佩佩與穆拉特被追擊至城外。革命後撤入山區主持抵抗的神父梅爾卡蒂，則是遊擊時期的實際領袖。
peopleEn: La Masa was the hinge of the revolution. In the parliament he argued that Sicily should keep its own charter and administrative autonomy; after the rising he was elected president of the Chamber and became head of the government, and he organised the armed men of the whole island into a single Esercito Siciliano. In April 1848 that force of volunteers marched north under La Masa and Roselli along the road to Milan, intending to join the insurgents of Lombardy; the march was abandoned over supply and disagreements in command, but La Masa gained prestige from it. At the same time his policies collided repeatedly with the officers and the aristocratic party, and he was finally arrested in the autumn of 1848 and exiled to Malta. Settimo was the military core: as minister of war he tightened the discipline, the organisation and the depot system of the volunteers, and in May 1849 the parliament named him commander-in-chief of the Sicilian army; he directed the defence of the Mole and the sea castle in the last siege. Ferdinand II was the decision maker on the other side: after the events in the theatre he was forced to give way, promulgated a constitution for the Two Sicilies in April 1848 and swore it at Naples on 15 May, but soon came into open collision with the Sicilian parliament and summoned the Spanish, Austrian and French auxiliaries to turn against his own subjects. Vincenzo Gioberti, prime minister of Piedmont, sent encouragement in the name of the Italian nation, but could not prevent French intervention, and the republican wing of the Sicilian parliament, with exiles such as Giuseppe Mazzini, turned instead to doubt the moderate line. The clash in Naples itself was suppressed by Carlo di Chiodo, commander of the royal troops: on 25 May he bombarded the fortress of Sant'Elmo and dispersed the National Guard that refused to disband, its leaders Guglielmo Pepe and Girolamo Murat being pursued out of the city. The priest Carmine Mercanti, who withdrew into the mountains after the revolution and led the resistance there, was the effective leader of the guerrilla phase.
kits: 本卡的雷管步槍代表的是一八四〇年代法軍的裝備水準，底火在海霧、潮氣與硝煙裡仍然擊發可靠，射程也較火繩槍拉長，這正是法軍遠征團在巴勒莫一線最倚重的步槍類型：法軍一八四四年式米涅式雷管槍，配紙包定裝藥，槍身有環形刺刀座可加掛刺刀。相反地，革命方在起義最初奪到的武器是波旁王室的舊式火繩米涅槍，即佛羅倫薩式十四線與十六線、那不勒斯式等口徑不一的槍械，數量以千計，卻沒有統一口徑、沒有制式彈藥，也沒有可用的刺刀；城防軍與民兵手中的獵槍與短管火槍同樣五花八門。波旁常備軍本身也在一八四〇年代逐步雷管化，但更替緩慢，野戰部隊仍混用兩代步槍，並配備舊式野砲與攻城砲。西西里島的砲兵規模有限，海防主要靠王宮沿岸與港口的岸砲；外來干預者帶來了最要緊的東西：法軍的攻城砲與騎兵，配合分艦隊的蒸汽戰艦與艦炮，可在陸上攻勢之前先行摧毀港口砲台。運輸同樣受制於島嶼條件：西西里在一八四〇年代末才開始鋪設鐵路，遠征軍與義軍的補給多靠沿海帆船、馬車與牛車，缺鐵路意味著糧草與彈藥的運送速度遠低於歐洲大陸。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card represents the standard of French equipment in the 1840s: the priming composition fired reliably in sea mist, damp and powder smoke, and the range was longer than that of the flint musket, which is exactly why the French expeditionary corps leaned on this class of musket on the approaches to Palermo, the Model 1844 French Minié percussion musket with paper cartridges and a socket bayonet. The revolution's opposite side, in the first days of the rising, seized the older flintlock muskets of the Bourbon royal arsenal: the fourteen- and sixteen-line Fiorentina patterns and the Neapolitan pattern, calibres that did not match one another, thousands of muskets with no uniform calibre, no standard ammunition and no serviceable bayonets, while the hunting guns and short weapons in the hands of the city guards and the militias were just as heterogeneous. The Bourbon regular army itself was gradually converting to percussion during the 1840s, but slowly, so that field units still mixed two generations of musket and carried old field guns and siege pieces. The artillery establishment of Sicily was small, and coastal defence rested mainly on the shore batteries of the royal palace and of the harbour; what the foreign intervention brought was the most important thing of all, French siege guns and cavalry, supported by steam warships and their guns in the squadrons, which could destroy the harbour batteries before the land assault began. Supply was likewise at the mercy of the island's geography: railways only began to be laid in Sicily in the late 1840s, and both the expeditionary corps and the insurgents drew their food, ammunition and material largely from coastal sailing vessels, carts and ox-waggons, so that without railways the movement of supplies was far slower than on the European continent.
tactics: 這場戰爭包含三種截然不同的戰術樣本。第一種是一八四八年一月十日夜的「奪庫式起義」：數千群眾憑藉夜色、人數與街巷的狹窄，同時衝入王宮、軍械庫與警察署，把成箱的火繩步槍搬走並在數小時內分給市民；軍隊因分散駐防而無法集結，武器就這樣從國家的庫房變成了起義者的身體延伸。第二種是義軍北進時的長距離行軍與會師企圖：以營為單位沿大道推進，試圖在米蘭方向與倫巴第義軍會師，卻沒有統一指揮，也沒有後勤計劃，行軍數週之後便在軍紀與糧秣上潰散。第三種也是最要緊的，是一八四九年對巴勒莫的圍城：法軍先用分艦隊封鎖港口，切斷城內的糧食來源，再用攻城砲與輕型野砲向外圍據點（維拉格蘭德、馬里內奧、卡里尼一線）逐一射擊與攻取，把守軍壓進莫萊長堤與海堡之間狹小的城防圈；守軍依託城牆射孔、屋頂射位與街壘交叉火力，在狹窄街巷裡抵禦縱隊衝鋒，法軍因此屢攻不克，最後靠集中砲火與工兵同時封住長堤兩端才奪下陣地。整體看，這是一場「封鎖加攻城砲」對「城牆加近距離火網」的較量，起義方在正面火力上佔優，在糧食、砲兵與海上交通上則全面落後。
tacticsEn: The war contained three quite different tactical models. The first was the rising of 10 January 1848, a seizure of the arsenal: several thousand men, using the night, their numbers and the narrowness of the streets, pushed at the same time into the royal palace, the armoury and the police offices, carried off the muskets by the crate and distributed them to the citizens within a few hours; the troops, dispersed in their garrisons, could not assemble, and the weapons passed in a single night from the stores of the state to the bodies of the insurgents. The second was the long march north and the plan to join forces: the volunteers advanced in battalion along the main roads in the direction of Milan to meet the insurgents of Lombardy, but without a unified command or a supply plan, and the column came apart within weeks over discipline and rations. The third, and the decisive one, was the siege of Palermo in 1849. The French first blockaded the port with their squadrons, cutting the city's supply of food, then worked through the outlying positions along the lines of Villagrande, Marineo and Carini with siege guns and light field pieces, and pressed the garrison back into the narrow defensive ring between the Mole and the sea castle. The garrison fought from the loopholes of the walls, from firing positions on the roofs and from barricades, meeting the attacking columns with cross fire in the narrow streets, and for that reason the French assaults failed repeatedly; only by concentrating their guns and by closing both ends of the mole with the engineers at once did they finally take the position. Taken as a whole, this was a trial of blockade and siege artillery against walls and a close-range web of fire: the insurgents were superior in frontal fire, and badly inferior in food, artillery and sea communications.
data: 可核對的時間點與數字如下：一八四八年一月九日晚，巴勒莫劇院內爆發要求憲法的呼聲，十日夜至十一日清晨群眾奪取軍械庫，國王於一月十一日前後被迫同意頒憲；西西里眾議院於一八四八年二月開議；四月十八日國王為兩西西里頒布憲法，四月二十一日西西里議會通過以一八一二年西班牙憲法為藍本的本地憲法，五月十五日國王在那不勒斯宣誓接受；五月二十五日那不勒斯聖埃爾莫堡被國王軍隊炮擊，國民警衛隊瓦解；西班牙輔助軍於一八四八年五月登陸，奧地利輔助軍於七月登陸、十一月撤走；法國遠征軍於一八四八年十一月自墨西拿登陸，兵力約一萬二千人，配火炮數十門，並自一八四九年一月起封鎖巴勒莫港；外圍據點於一八四九年三月至四月間被逐一攻取，莫萊長堤與海堡於五月二十四日陷落。自劇院事件到城市陷落，前後約十六個月。傷亡與俘虜的數字各方統計出入甚大，不宜引用；可以確定的是守軍在最後階段已無餘糧，配給被削減到不足以支撐長時間抵抗。
dataEn: The dates and figures that can be checked run as follows. On the evening of 9 January 1848 the cry for a constitution rose inside the theatre at Palermo; during the night of the tenth and the morning of the eleventh the crowd seized the armoury, and around 11 January the king was forced to agree to a constitution. The Sicilian parliament opened in February 1848; on 18 April the king promulgated a constitution for the Two Sicilies; on 21 April the Sicilian parliament approved a constitution of its own based on the Spanish constitution of 1812; and on 15 May the king swore to it at Naples. On 25 May the fortress of Sant'Elmo in Naples was bombarded by the royal troops and the National Guard broke up. The Spanish auxiliaries landed in May 1848, the Austrian auxiliaries landed in July and withdrew in November, and the French expeditionary corps landed at Messina in November 1848 with about twelve thousand men and some dozens of guns, beginning the blockade of Palermo harbour in January 1849. The outlying positions were taken one by one between March and April 1849, and the Mole and the sea castle fell on 24 May. Between the events in the theatre and the fall of the city there were about sixteen months. Casualty and prisoner figures differ widely between sources and are better not quoted; what is certain is that in the last phase the garrison had no reserves of food left, and rations were cut to a level that could not support resistance for long.
cause: 這場革命的直接起因，是國王費迪南德二世在一八四八年一月把原定召開的西西里議會延期，並要求議會不得審議「西西里問題」，也就是西西里在兩西西里王國之內的地位、海關與司法制度。這個舉動之所以能引爆全島，是因為西西里自中世紀起就有自己的常設代表機構與獨立憲章，一八一二年的西西里憲法更給了這份傳統近代形式；一八一六年波旁王室把那不勒斯王國與西西里合併之後，議會被解散，島嶼成為「被治理的邊疆」，而每年春天在巴勒莫舉行的遊行與演說，一直把自治的訴求保存在民間。背後還有兩層壓力。其一是經濟的：一八四七年西西里歉收、糧價上漲，「麵包與自由」的呼聲在城鎮與鄉村同時響起；王室財政窘迫，又在一八四七年同法國爆發關稅爭端，軍費與稅制都岌岌可危。其二是歐洲性的：一八四八年二月巴黎革命、三月二十二日米蘭起義的消息傳到巴勒莫，義大利民族運動的整體氣氛把島上的不滿推向了武裝起義。就連北進的義軍本身也帶著這層理想：以「全義大利」的名義北上會師，儘管島上的議會與政府其實更在意自己的憲章。這說明西西里革命既是歐洲革命的一環，又帶著與那不勒斯決裂的地方色彩。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the revolution was King Ferdinand II's decision in January 1848 to postpone the meeting of the Sicilian parliament, and to require that it should not debate the Sicilian question, that is, the position of Sicily within the Two Sicilies, its customs regime and its courts. The decision could set the whole island alight because Sicily had possessed its own standing representative body and its own charter since the Middle Ages, and the Sicilian constitution of 1812 had given that tradition a modern form; when the Bourbons united the Kingdom of Naples with Sicily in 1816, the parliament was dissolved and the island became a governed frontier, and the processions and speeches held in Palermo every spring kept the claim to autonomy alive in the towns. Two further pressures lay behind it. The first was economic: the harvest of 1847 failed in Sicily, the price of grain rose, and the cry for bread and freedom was heard in the towns and the countryside at once; the finances of the royal treasury were strained, and a customs war with France broke out in 1847, leaving both military expenditure and the tax system insecure. The second was European: the news of the Paris revolution in February 1848 and of the Milanese rising of 22 March reached Palermo, and the general atmosphere of the Italian national movement pushed the discontent of the island into armed insurrection. The volunteers who marched north carried the same idea with them, that they would join the general action in the name of all Italy, even though the parliament and the government of the island cared far more about their own charter. Sicily's revolution was therefore at once part of the European revolutions and coloured by a local strand that wanted to break with Naples.
impact: 西西里革命在軍事上失敗，在意大利統一史上卻留下幾道明顯的痕跡。第一，它讓外人看清波旁王朝的存續並非全靠自身：西班牙、奧地利與法國的援軍先後登陸，把一場島內的憲法爭議變成歐洲列強的干預，這既確認了意大利民族國家與正規軍之間的實力差距，也讓同一場革命在法國第二共和國的政策裡有了明確的位置——法國選擇以遠征維持歐洲既有秩序，而不是支持民族運動，這條取向在往後的意大利戰爭中一再出現。第二，它加深了意大利內部的路線分裂：以皮埃蒙特為首的溫和派想用「以法援換取承認」的方式取得倫巴第，而馬志尼式的共和派則認為西西里的失敗暴露了君主國途徑的空洞，西西里議會內部本來也分成君主立憲與共和兩派。第三，它的鎮壓留下政治遺產：波旁法於一八四九年五月廢除西西里議會、中止一八四八年憲法的實際運作、把行政與軍隊權力收歸那不勒斯，島嶼此後數年處於非常法與警察監控之下；這段「被征服省份」的經歷，十年後反而成為一八六〇年加里波第登陸時西西里義軍主動接應的心理基礎。第四，在軍事技術層面，這場圍城是海權時代的一次示範：一座沒有鐵路、糧食靠港口進口的沿海城市，在配備攻城砲與蒸汽砲艦的遠征軍面前必然崩解；起義方雖然能憑藉城牆與街壘在近距離上抵禦縱隊，卻無法同時解決糧食與彈藥。
impactEn: The Sicilian revolution failed militarily, yet it left clear traces in the history of Italian unification. First, it showed outsiders that the survival of the Bourbon monarchy did not rest on its own resources: the Spanish, Austrian and French auxiliaries landed in turn and turned a constitutional quarrel inside the island into an intervention by the European powers, which both confirmed the gap in strength between the Italian national forces and the regular armies and gave the same revolution a definite place in the policy of the French Second Republic, which chose to preserve the existing order in Europe by expedition rather than to back the national movements, a line that was to reappear in the Italian wars. Second, it deepened the split inside the Italian movement: the moderates led by Piedmont wanted to win Lombardy by trading French help for recognition, while Mazzini's republicans held that the Sicilian failure exposed the hollowness of the monarchical route, and the Sicilian parliament itself was already divided between constitutional monarchy and republic. Third, the repression left a political inheritance: the Bourbon law of May 1849 abolished the Sicilian parliament, suspended the working of the constitution of 1848 and concentrated administration and military power in Naples, leaving the island under emergency law and police surveillance for years; that experience of being a conquered province became, ten years later, the psychological reason why Sicilian volunteers welcomed Garibaldi's landing in 1860. Fourth, at the level of military technique, this siege was a demonstration of the age of sea power: a coastal city without railways, fed by its port, was bound to collapse before an expeditionary force equipped with siege guns and steam warships, and though the insurgents could hold a column at close quarters behind walls and barricades, they could not solve the problem of food and ammunition at the same time.
result: 一八四九年五月二十四日，法軍在砲火掩護下攻下莫萊長堤與海上城堡，進入巴勒莫；在此之前數日，議會、政府與主要武裝已撤往西西里中部山區，抵抗以游擊的形式延續到一八五〇年才被清剿完畢。結果是西西里議會被解散，一八四八年憲法停止運作，費迪南德二世恢復實質上的絕對統治，島上施行嚴厲的非常法與警察監控，直到一八六一年王國覆亡。從裝備與戰術看，這場戰爭的教訓相當清楚：起義方在第一階段最大的優勢，是能憑人數與夜色迅速奪取軍械庫，把一批火繩步槍變成民軍的武裝；但這批武器口徑雜亂、彈藥無源，配上缺失的野砲、騎兵與統一指揮，使他們無法在野外戰役中與配備攻城砲的縱隊對抗；守軍最後依靠的城牆射孔與近距離火網，也只能在糧食斷絕之前延續一段時間。雷管步槍在這裡的意義，則是展示了遠程火力對城防的壓制：底火不怕海霧與煙塵，進攻方能在較遠距離穩定射擊並封鎖射孔，而守方的火繩槍在潮濕的夜霧裡更容易失火——但真正決定勝負的，還是封鎖、糧食與砲火這三樣東西。
resultEn: On 24 May 1849 the French took the Mole and the sea castle under cover of their guns and entered Palermo; several days earlier the parliament, the government and the main body of the armed men had withdrawn into the mountains of central Sicily, where the resistance continued in guerrilla form until it was crushed in 1850. The result was the dissolution of the Sicilian parliament, the suspension of the constitution of 1848, and the restoration in substance of absolute rule by Ferdinand II, with severe emergency law and police surveillance on the island until the monarchy fell in 1861. In terms of equipment and tactics the lesson of this war is clear. The greatest advantage of the insurgents in the first phase was their ability to seize the arsenal quickly, by numbers and by night, and to turn a batch of flintlock muskets into the armament of the militia; but those weapons were of mixed calibre and their ammunition had no common source, and with no field guns, no cavalry and no unified command they could not meet the columns of an army equipped with siege artillery in open battle. The walls and the close-range web of fire on which the garrison finally relied could hold for no longer than the time it took for food to run out. The significance of the percussion rifle here was its demonstration of the pressure that long-range fire exerted on a city defence: the priming composition did not fear sea mist or powder smoke, so the attacker could fire steadily at longer range and seal the loopholes, while the flintlock muskets of the defenders were more prone to misfire in the damp of a night fog. But what really decided the outcome was the blockade, the food and the guns.
